# S10 normal CLI bounded gate (prepared; not executed)

Driver: normal-cli-driver.py, SHA efbd53c01af3ab740cf0d1f3a2da566aae355661ef9c35219bf274dca2fa2513. Base 11f922896377cb0d02bf481ef0df10f11a1cb4c4 plus final reviewed candidate. Coordinator must bind actual normal server and actual manager worker hashes and grant the sole window; no builds, imports or HTTP have been run by this owner.

One fixed owned index/worker installation; two sequential normal server processes using one fresh private DataDir, no safe-mode substitution. Child environment inherited unchanged (the S10_NORMAL_CLI_GRANTED launcher marker is already part of inherited environment); no proxy/TLS/HOME edits. Only exact http://127.0.0.1:39123, ten fixed method-path pairs, no query/fragment/credentials/redirect. Per-request owned PID/listener-inode check and strict allowed target. Product artifact requests remain on normal product HTTP policy. Fixture routes return only own index/binary, no CONNECT/upstream.

Warm sequence covers all eight actual SDK wrappers: explicit init → raw get_state → local DTO raw state → delete_config/delete_data → Scheduler.update → Manager.remove → Scheduler.remove exact global ID with wrong pid. Config seed/readback uses the isolated ordinary configuration API. Data deletion's nonempty SQLite proof belongs to the App gate; CLI only observes the owned empty-namespace wrapper. Init failure compares existing code-only host error, mutated conf and no post-failure getter, followed by same-PID recovery. This is not a claim of raw Python exception text crossing the SDK.

After self-remove, current HTTP returns, Manager.state=false/local=[], bound endpoint retains PID/counter, old job remains visible and executes once on that same worker. Only same owned job-completion state is polled; HTTP/transport/policy failures stop immediately. Job removal must not remove the API. Stop first normal host and observe all known worker identities gone; cold host gets a new worker from the existing installed artifact, empty config persists, transient job/removal counters do not replay, plugin remains installed. Final stop must be normal exit0 with no forced cleanup. Every raw non-login HTTP response, child logs/exit, owned executable SHA and before/after driver inputs retained. Login/credentials stay private and are not logged or published.

Source projection limits: normal CLI is target host evidence, not original full Python host/timer firing; exact original source components/SQLite and pending APScheduler observations remain separate. No browser/UI, real plugin, downloader, NAS, CI or final delivery claim.
